correctness.rationale: Exact positive covariance recursion and rank-one resolvent give the necessary/sufficient rational inequality. The normalized return-gain derivative is manifestly strictly positive for all positive steps. The frequency derivative has a strictly increasing positive-power-coefficient cubic numerator, proving a unique minimum at fixed step. Compactness and a strict-minimum comparison imply one unique optimal frequency in the specified 2<tau<4 regime. `verify.py` independently confirms four symbolic identities and 104 finite covariance eigenvalue comparisons; finite tests do not stand in for universal proofs.

value.rationale: One-coordinate multiplicative noise is a natural minimal noncommuting stochastic oscillator test. The theorem supplies an exact implementable sharp stability boundary, shows that angular coupling can restore Euler mean-square stability even when the zero-frequency model has no stable positive step, and proves a unique best frequency; too-fast rotation is again detrimental. These are structural and parameter-optimal facts beyond the routine general no-reentry argument.
